mapper.select: SELECT * FROM case_activity WHERE case_id = #{caseId} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT * FROM case_activity WHERE deleted = 0 AND GREATEST( COALESCE(last_debug_time, '1970-01-01'), COALESCE(last_flow_execute_time, '1970-01-01'), COALESCE(last_suite_execute_time, '1970-01-01'), COALESCE(last_view_time, '1970-01-01') ) < #{threshold}

SELECT ca.id, ca.case_id, ac.name AS case_name, ac.application_id, app.name AS application_name, ca.last_debug_time, ca.last_flow_execute_time, ca.last_suite_execute_time, ca.last_view_time, GREATEST( COALESCE(ca.last_debug_time, '1970-01-01'), COALESCE(ca.last_flow_execute_time, '1970-01-01'), COALESCE(ca.last_suite_execute_time, '1970-01-01'), COALESCE(ca.last_view_time, '1970-01-01') ) AS last_active_time, ca.calculated_at, ca.created_at, ca.updated_at FROM case_activity ca LEFT JOIN api_case ac ON ca.case_id = ac.id AND ac.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN application app ON ac.application_id = app.id AND app.deleted = 0 WHERE ca.case_id = #{caseId} AND ca.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN GREATEST( COALESCE(ca.last_debug_time, '1970-01-01'), COALESCE(ca.last_flow_execute_time, '1970-01-01'), COALESCE(ca.last_suite_execute_time, '1970-01-01'), COALESCE(ca.last_view_time, '1970-01-01') ) >= #{threshold} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count, SUM(CASE WHEN GREATEST( COALESCE(ca.last_debug_time, '1970-01-01'), COALESCE(ca.last_flow_execute_time, '1970-01-01'), COALESCE(ca.last_suite_execute_time, '1970-01-01'), COALESCE(ca.last_view_time, '1970-01-01') ) < #{threshold} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inactive_count FROM case_activity ca LEFT JOIN api_case ac ON ca.case_id = ac.id AND ac.deleted = 0 WHERE ca.deleted = 0
AND ac.application_id = #{applicationId}
